title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
code:
Let word be "abcabcbb".
Let last be the last position of word.

For every finish from start to last.
Let repeated be 0.
For every earlier from start to one less than finish, if character earlier of word is character finish of word, add 1 to repeated.
Let span be finish minus start plus 1.
If repeated is 0 and span is greater than best, set best to span.

Print best.

title: String to Integer (atoi)
code:
Let word be "   -42".
Let final be one less than the number of characters in word.
Let position be 0.
Let value be 0.
Let sign be 1.
Repeat while position is at most final and character position of word is 32.
Add 1 to position.

If position is at most final and character position of word is 45, set sign to -1, add 1 to position.
If position is at most final and character position of word is 43, add 1 to position.
Repeat while position is at most final and character position of word is at least 48 and character position of word is at most 57.
Set value to value times 10 plus character position of word minus 48.
Add 1 to position.

If sign is -1, set value to 0 minus value.
If value is more than 2147483647, set value to 2147483647.
If value is less than -2147483648, set value to -2147483648.
Print value.

If value is at least 400, append "CD" to result, set value to value minus 400.
Repeat while value is at least 100, append "C" to result, set value to value minus 100.
If value is at least 90, append "XC" to result, set value to value minus 90.
If value is at least 50, append "L" to result, set value to value minus 50.
If value is at least 40, append "XL" to result, set value to value minus 40.
Repeat while value is at least 10, append "X" to result, set value to value minus 10.
If value is at least 9, append "IX" to result, set value to value minus 9.
If value is at least 5, append "V" to result, set value to value minus 5.
If value is at least 4, append "IV" to result, set value to value minus 4.
Repeat while value is at least 1, append "I" to result, set value to value minus 1.
Print result.

If symbol is 67, set current to 100.
If symbol is 76, set current to 50.
If symbol is 88, set current to 10.
If symbol is 86, set current to 5.

If following is 68, set following to 500.
If following is 67, set following to 100.
If following is 76, set following to 50.
If following is 88, set following to 10.
